description: INFRARISK Bologna road and Croatia rail natural-hazard stress tests provides INFRARISK stress tests combining physical damage and network-disruption consequences. The provider is European Commission CORDIS / INFRARISK consortium. Geographical and temporal coverage: The completed EU project applied seismic and cascading-landslide scenarios to roads in Bologna and flood scenarios to Croatian railways. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The cases demonstrate a multi-network method; simulated losses are not observed damage totals. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
